title: Weekend Update-Melissa Villaseñor on Hispanic Heritage Month
text: Well, Hispanic Heritage Month just ended. Here to talk about it is Melissa Villasenor. ¿Qué tal, mi amigo? Muy bien, gracias. ¿Y contigo? No, I'm shutting this down right now. Sorry, sorry. So, Hispanic Heritage Month just ended. That's right, Colin. This month is actually a great time to embrace Hispanics and our heritage, which is why it was so surprising that my boyfriend broke up with me this past month. Oh, so is that what you're actually here to talk about? Yep, I tricked you, Colin. I said I was a badass fan of Caratage, and if you said no, you're racist. Anyway, I'm super single right now.
